race.description: Race Day Medical Pty Ltd F&M Mdn Plate
race.comment: UNKECHAUG (12) brings the clearest class edge, dropping out of the G3 Red Roses Stakes after being beaten just under three lengths on Oaks Day, with a Listed fifth beaten a length and a half the run before. Back to maiden grade, she naturally looks well placed. KADESH (4) has placed four times from five starts and three times from four tries around 1100m, so she has the consistency to take a minor role if forward enough first-up. SABRINA (9) has been okay in two runs to date and has minor claims. VESPERS (6) last start narrow Cranbourne second in stronger company reads well enough, especially with an awkward start. Include.
